name: Formal Methods for Security
description: Formal verification, proofs, and verified implementations of security-critical systems and protocols.
narrative:
The earliest papers in this list show formal methods spreading across two very different fronts at once. On the protocol side, "A Formal Analysis of 5G Authentication" (CCS 2018) and "LTEInspector" (NDSS 2018) used symbolic model checkers to find real flaws in the cellular standards that billions of people rely on, while "DEEPSEC" (S&P 2018) pushed the theory of automatically deciding equivalence properties for cryptographic protocols. On a parallel track, researchers began applying verification to machine learning and low-level systems: "AI2" (S&P 2018) and "Formal Security Analysis of Neural Networks using Symbolic Intervals" (USENIX 2018) brought abstract interpretation and interval analysis to certify neural-network robustness, and "ZEUS" (NDSS 2018) opened the smart-contract verification wave by analyzing safety of Ethereum contracts.

Two big shifts define 2019-2020. First, smart contracts became a dominant subarea, moving from bug-finding toward sound, provable guarantees: "VerX" (S&P 2020) proved functional properties, "VERISMART" (S&P 2020) targeted arithmetic safety, and "eThor" (CCS 2020) delivered a provably sound static analysis grounded in formal EVM semantics, complemented by executable Solidity semantics (S&P 2020) and bounded model checkers like "ETHBMC" (USENIX 2020). Second, verification graduated from models to real, deployed code. "Simple High-Level Code for Cryptographic Arithmetic" (S&P 2019), "EverCrypt" (S&P 2020), and "The Last Mile" (S&P 2020) produced machine-checked, high-speed cryptographic implementations all the way down to assembly, while "EverParse" (USENIX 2019) and "VRASED" (USENIX 2019) verified parsers and a hardware/software remote-attestation co-design. The 5G/cellular thread also matured with "5GReasoner" (CCS 2019) and component-based 5G-AKA analysis (NDSS 2019).

The Spectre disclosures triggered a third wave: formalizing microarchitectural leakage. "Spectector" (S&P 2020) gave a principled semantics for detecting speculative information flows, "InSpectre" (CCS 2020) formally modeled and fixed microarchitectural vulnerabilities, and "Hardware-Software Contracts for Secure Speculation" (S&P 2021) introduced a contract abstraction that was consolidated by "SoK: Practical Foundations for Software Spectre Defenses" (S&P 2022). Information-flow guarantees also reached hardware in "HyperFlow" (CCS 2018) and whole systems in "A Secure and Formally Verified Linux KVM Hypervisor" (S&P 2021).

By 2021-2023 the field reads as a maturing discipline: systematization papers like "SoK: Computer-Aided Cryptography" (S&P 2021) survey the toolchain, foundational protocols get end-to-end treatment ("The Provable Security of Ed25519", S&P 2021; "The EMV Standard: Break, Fix, Verify", S&P 2021), and core tools themselves are re-engineered, as in the major "ProVerif with Lemmas, Induction, Fast Subsumption" overhaul (S&P 2022). The frontier now reaches richer properties and shared infrastructure: temporal properties of contracts ("SmartPulse", S&P 2021), compiler infrastructure spanning proof systems and verification ("CirC", S&P 2022), distributed-systems foundations ("Foundations of Dynamic BFT", S&P 2022), and economic/game-theoretic security ("Clockwork Finance", S&P 2023) — extending formal reasoning from "is this code correct" to "is this system's incentive structure safe."

milestones.title: AI2: Safety and Robustness Certification of Neural Networks with Abstract Interpretation
milestones.note: brought abstract interpretation to certifying neural-network robustness, seeding the verified-ML subarea

milestones.title: A Formal Analysis of 5G Authentication
milestones.note: applied symbolic model checking to a real-world cellular standard, exposing flaws and setting the template for protocol verification at scale

milestones.title: Simple High-Level Code for Cryptographic Arithmetic - With Proofs, Without Compromises
milestones.note: showed verification could yield real, deployable cryptographic code with machine-checked functional correctness

milestones.title: EverCrypt: A Fast, Verified, Cross-Platform Cryptographic Provider
milestones.note: delivered a comprehensive verified, high-performance crypto library, proving end-to-end verification is practical for production use

milestones.title: Spectector: Principled Detection of Speculative Information Flows
milestones.note: gave a principled semantics for speculative leakage, founding the formal study of Spectre-class microarchitectural attacks

milestones.title: eThor: Practical and Provably Sound Static Analysis of Ethereum Smart Contracts
milestones.note: anchored smart-contract analysis in formal EVM semantics with provable soundness, raising the bar beyond bug-finding

milestones.title: SoK: Computer-Aided Cryptography
milestones.note: systematized the now-mature field of machine-checkable cryptographic design and verification

milestones.title: ProVerif with Lemmas, Induction, Fast Subsumption, and Much More
milestones.note: overhauled one of the most widely used protocol verifiers, expanding what symbolic verification can prove in practice
